project.name: lending-library
project.description: A small Java lending library app using Jersey (Grizzly), Hibernate and H2.

nodes.name: export-csv.md
nodes.summary: Notes that GET /loans emits a ';'-separated CSV-like format that spreadsheet users depend on.

nodes.name: reports-spec.md
nodes.summary: Specification of a monthly per-member lending report whose original code is lost.

nodes.name: pom.xml
nodes.summary: Maven build for the lending-library app: Java 17, Jersey/Grizzly, Hibernate and H2.

nodes.name: run.sh
nodes.summary: Shell script that builds with Maven and starts lib.App.

nodes.name: App.java
nodes.summary: Entry point: wires the JPA EntityManagerFactory, repository and JAX-RS resources onto a Grizzly HTTP server.

nodes.name: AboutPage.java
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource serving GET /about from the static about.html.

nodes.name: FinePayments.java
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource for POST /payments/{id} that charges a late fee via an external payment gateway.

nodes.name: LateFeeView.java
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource rendering the late fee HTML page for a loan (25c/day, cap $10, 2-day grace).

nodes.name: Loan.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity for the LOAN table with a 14-day due date rule.

nodes.name: LoanRepository.java
nodes.summary: JPA repository for loans with read/write transaction helpers.

nodes.name: LoanResource.java
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource for /loans: list, get, lend and return, emitting ';'-separated lines.

nodes.name: persistence.xml
nodes.summary: JPA persistence unit 'library' using in-memory H2, schema auto-create and seed script.

nodes.name: seed.sql
nodes.summary: Seed data inserting three sample loans into LOAN.

nodes.name: about.html
nodes.summary: Static About page with opening hours and contact info.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Starts the Grizzly server and registers resources.

nodes.name: pay
nodes.summary: Calls the payment gateway to charge a loan's fee.

nodes.name: page
nodes.summary: Computes and renders a loan's late fee.

nodes.name: all
nodes.summary: Lists all loans ordered by id.

nodes.name: lend
nodes.summary: Creates and persists a new loan.

nodes.name: LOAN
nodes.summary: Table LOAN mapped by JPA entity Loan
